svg.text: Tags with the same name are joined together: every 5V tag goes to the ESP32 VIN pin, every 3V3 tag to the 3V3 pin, every GND tag to GND.
• 1kΩ = brown black red · 2kΩ = red black red · 10kΩ = brown black orange
• IRLZ44N: printed side facing you → legs G · D · S (left to right)
• 1N4007: the silver stripe end goes to 3V3 (motor red)
• Motors run on 3V3, never 5V · sensors run on 5V (VIN)
• All GND tags must be connected together
